steps.title: Prepare Gastric Biopsy Samples
steps.instruction: Process gastric biopsy samples (antrum and/or body stomach tissue) using PBS 1X.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the gastric biopsy of each patient in an Eppendorf tube with 80 µL of PBS 1X.
Macerate the biopsy completely using an activated carbon swab and add another 80 µL of PBS 1X.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the sample using Buffer ALT and Buffer AL.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Buffer ALT and incubate overnight at 56 °C with shaking.
Centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 1 minute to remove drops from the lid.
Add 200 µL of Buffer AL, mix thoroughly by vortexing for 15 seconds, and incubate at 70 °C for 10 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.
Add 200 µL of ethanol (96-100%).
Vortex for 15 seconds.
Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove drops from the lid.

steps.title: DNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the QIAamp Mini spin column and wash the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Pipet the mixture onto a QIAamp Mini spin column in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (or 8000 rpm) for 1 minute; discard the flow-through and collection tube.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and add 500 µL of buffer AW1.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (or 8000 rpm) for 1 minute; discard the flow-through and collection tube.
Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and add 500 µL of Buffer AW2.
Centrifuge at full speed (20,000 x g or 14,000 rpm) for 3 minutes; discard the flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Dry Column and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual wash buffer and elute the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 1 minute to eliminate Buffer AW2 carryover.
Place the column in a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and add 200 µL of warm molecular grade water.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (or 8000 rpm) for 1 minute to elute the DNA.
Optional: Repeat the elution step with an additional 200 µL of warm molecular grade water for increased yield.
